supersession.superseded_clause: The inline Node process consumed its only invocation and allowed no retry or substitute renderer.
supersession.replacement: Authorize one final process that executes a frozen CommonJS file. No JavaScript source is transported through PowerShell argument parsing. The renderer, source SVG, output settings, output path, and all art constraints remain unchanged.
supersession.reason: The first process failed while Node parsed quote-stripped inline source, before JavaScript evaluation or Sharp loading. A file-based program removes the demonstrated transport failure rather than repeating the failed approach.

authority.user_scope: The current user request explicitly authorizes end-to-end concept-art generation and construction of the Career World site, including autonomous art and QA lanes.
authority.director_decision: Continue from the proven transport failure with one materially different, file-based renderer process and no further retry.

frozen_renderer_program.program_role: Load the frozen SVG with Sharp, apply the already-approved deterministic settings, write the one final PNG path, validate PNG/1536x1024/three channels, and emit one JSON receipt.

single_authorized_recovery_process.renderer: Node.js 22.16.0 with repo-local Sharp 0.34.5 and libvips 8.17.3
single_authorized_recovery_process.escalation_reason: The installed Node executable is outside the workspace sandbox and sandboxed execution returned Access is denied; all authorized writes remain inside the workspace.
single_authorized_recovery_process.exact_powershell_command_serialization: UTF-8 without BOM; LF line endings; no trailing LF
